Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j

Interface LogHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileHandler, ConsoleHandler, FileHandler, RotatingFileHandler
public interface LogHandler
Represents a functional interface for handling log entries.

  • Method Details

    • name

      String name()
      Retrieves the name of the log entry handler.
      Returns:
      the name of the log entry handler as a String

    • isEnabled

      default boolean isEnabled(LogLevel lvl)
      Determines whether logging is enabled for a specific log level.
      Parameters:
      lvl - the log level to check
      Returns:
      true if logging is enabled for the specified log level, otherwise false

    • handle

      void handle(long timestamp, String loggerName, LogLevel lvl, @Nullable String mrk, @Nullable MDC mdc, @Nullable Location loc, CharSequence msg, @Nullable Throwable t)
      Handles a log entry.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the timestamp of the log entry (milliseconds since epoch)
      loggerName - the name of the logger
      lvl - the log level of the log entry
      mrk - the marker associated with the log entry, or null if none
      mdc - the MDC associated with the log entry
      loc - the location of the call site (may be null)
      msg - the message of the log entry
      t - the throwable associated with the log entry, or null if none

    • setFilter

      void setFilter(LogFilter filter)
      Sets the filter to be used for determining which log entries should be processed.
      Parameters:
      filter - the filter used to include or exclude log entries; must not be null

    • getFilter

      LogFilter getFilter()
      Retrieves the current filter used for determining which log entries should be processed.
      Returns:
      the LogEntryFilter that is currently set; never null

    • shutdown

      void shutdown()
      Initiates the shutdown process for the log handler. This method should be called to release any resources, perform cleanup tasks, and ensure finalization work for the logging system associated with this handler. Once this method is invoked, the log handler should not be expected to process any further log entries.

    • isLocationNeeded

      boolean isLocationNeeded()
      Indicates whether location information is required for log entries.
      Returns:
      true if location information is needed, otherwise false
